title: Image-Based Intrusion Detection System for GPS Spoofing in Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
summary: A research repository of Jupyter notebooks building an image-based intrusion detection system for GPS spoofing attacks on UAVs, including notebooks that generate synthetic tabular spoofing data for model training and evaluation. It calls SDV's single-table synthesizers (GaussianCopula, CTGAN, TVAE) and its evaluation API to fit, save, and quality-check synthetic spoofing datasets.
